name: Fey-Born Sorcery
body:
Enchantments you cast are enhanced with the fey magic inherent to your very nature.

Prerequisite: Fey bloodline sorcerer or fey creature type

Benefit: When using a spell of the Enchantment school, add +4 to all opposed Charisma checks.
